definitions.name: O2B.MOD
definitions.body: 'MB' BIND 'MA' BIND MA MA MB DIV FLOOR MB MUL SUB
definitions.note: a b to a mod b (a - b*floor(a/b)); lifts over a Vector a

definitions.name: O2B.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE [ 'DD' BIND DN DD O2B.MOD 0 GT NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer to the ascending Vector of its positive divisors

definitions.name: O2B.CSTEP
definitions.body: 'CE' BIND 'CV' BIND 1 CV 3 MUL 1 ADD CV 2 DIV CV 2 O2B.MOD 0 GT SELECT CV 1 EQ SELECT
definitions.note: SCAN step (acc elem): next Collatz value of acc, staying at 1; elem ignored

definitions.name: O2B.GSUM
definitions.body: 'GV' BIND 'GK' BIND GK GV GROUP 'GG' BIND GG KEYS GG VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of keys, Vector of numbers to Record key -> sum of its numbers, keys in first-appearance order

definitions.name: O2B.LINE
definitions.body: 'OL' BIND OL 'price' GET 'PP' BIND 0 OL 'qty' GET PP MUL PP NIL? SELECT
definitions.note: order Record to qty times price, or 0 when it has no price

definitions.name: O2B.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'MN' BIND MS MN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS MN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty numeric Vector (mean of the two middle values when even)

definitions.name: O2B.DEV
definitions.note: Vector of numbers to each number minus the mean

solutions.ledger.by_name: 'LG' BIND LG [ 0 GET ] MAP LG [ 1 GET ] MAP O2B.GSUM
solutions.ledger.top_name: 'LG' BIND LG [ 0 GET ] MAP LG [ 1 GET ] MAP O2B.GSUM G0A.TOPKEY
solutions.ledger.debtors: 'LG' BIND LG [ 0 GET ] MAP LG [ 1 GET ] MAP O2B.GSUM 'LR' BIND LR KEYS LR VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'LG' BIND LG LG [ 1 GET ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.messy.title: LOWER G0A.WORDS [ G0B.CAP ] MAP G0B.SPACED
solutions.number.primes: 'PN' BIND 1 PN RANGE [ O2B.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
solutions.number.binary: 'BN' BIND [ 32 16 8 4 2 1 ] 'BP' BIND BN BP DIV FLOOR 2 O2B.MOD STR BP BN GT NOT G0B.COUNT -1 MUL TAKE JOIN
solutions.number.collatz: 'CN' BIND CN 1 COLLECT 1 150 RANGE CN [ O2B.CSTEP ] SCAN CONCAT [ 1 EQ NOT ] FILTER LENGTH
solutions.orders.report: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ O2B.LINE ] MAP G0A.SUM 2 FORMAT
solutions.orders.unpriced: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ 'price' GET NIL? ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.orders.qty_by_sku: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET 'OD' BIND OD [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OD [ 'qty' GET ] MAP O2B.GSUM
solutions.orders.top_sku: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET 'OD' BIND OD [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OD [ 'qty' GET ] MAP O2B.GSUM G0A.TOPKEY
solutions.orders.tag_counts: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ 'tags' GET NIL? NOT ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.series.mad: 'SV' BIND SV O2B.MEDIAN 'SM' BIND SV SM SUB 'SD' BIND SD SD -1 MUL MAX O2B.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'SV' BIND SV -2 DROP SV 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD SV 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'RV' BIND RV RV 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.stats.variance: O2B.DEV 'QD' BIND QD QD MUL G0A.MEAN
solutions.stats.stddev: O2B.DEV 'QD' BIND QD QD MUL G0A.MEAN SQRT
solutions.stats.range: SORT 'RS' BIND RS -1 GET RS 0 GET SUB
solutions.stats.normalize: 'NV' BIND NV SORT 'NS' BIND NS 0 GET 'NMIN' BIND NS -1 GET NMIN SUB 'NR' BIND NV NMIN SUB NR DIV
solutions.text.acronym: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
